name: Mechacerberus
pages: Well, you made it all the way through the levels of the Mars labyrinth, only to find yourself… facing a massive, 3-headed robot dog?!

pages.text: Behold: the Mechacerberus boss, found naturally only in the final room of the Mars labyrinth

pages: Struggling to fight the mechacerberus boss?  Maybe try waiting for the right moment…

pages.text: Lucky enough to get one of these as a drop? Sweet! If you didn't, don't worry, he can be resummoned… if you dare…
Don't worry, this won't summon the Wither… I'm pretty sure.

pages: If you have been lucky enough to acquire a mechacerberus core, and a few mechadog heads, and you're not interested in fighting another boss, you can instead…craft your own Mechacerberus!
Once you've crafted a white one, try putting it back in the crafting table with a dye of your choice!  Collect all 16 colors!
The crafted Mechacerberus will be tamed to you, immediately, as soon as you place the item in the world!
